summary.headline: Dongkuk Holdings' unit Ferrum Infra to cancel 545,455 redeemable preferred shares for KRW 3.0bn
summary.what_happened: On Nov 24, 2026, the board of Ferrum Infra, a subsidiary of Dongkuk Holdings, resolved to cancel 545,455 redeemable preferred shares, to be carried out off-market on Nov 27, 2026. The cancellation follows shareholder redemption requests and is funded from retained earnings, so there is no reduction in share capital; the scheduled redemption amount is KRW 3.0bn at KRW 5,500 per share. After the cancellation, 4,018,173 redeemable preferred shares remain outstanding.
summary.why_it_matters: In Korea, a share cancellation of this kind generally means a subsidiary is redeeming and retiring part of its preferred stock, typically at the request of holders, with the cash paid out of accumulated earnings. Such filings usually reduce the number of outstanding preferred shares without changing the paid-in capital.
